When passing buffers from eBPF stack space into a helper function
ARG_PTR_TO_STACK argument type for helpers available. The verifier makes sure
that such buffers are initialized
However
column2: the downside with this is that we have a couple of helper functions

column1: such as bpf_skb_load_bytes() that fill out the passed buffer in the expected
success case anyway
column2: so zero initializing them prior to the helper call is

column1: unneeded/wasted instructions in the eBPF program that can be avoided.
Therefore
column2: add a new helper function argument type called ARG_PTR_TO_RAW_STACK.

column1: The idea is to skip the STACK_MISC check in check_stack_boundary() and color
the related stack slots as STACK_MISC after we checked all call arguments.
Helper functions using ARG_PTR_TO_RAW_STACK must make sure that every path of
the helper function will fill the provided buffer area
any uninitialized stack memory. This f.e. means that error paths need to
memset() the buffers
column2: but the expected fast-path doesn't have to do this

column1: anymore.
Since there's no such helper needing more than at most one ARG_PTR_TO_RAW_STACK
argument
column2: we can keep it simple and don't need to check for multiple areas.

column1: Should in future such a use-case really appear
will make sure we implement support for it first.
